subject: Weekly exec checkpoint: OKR snapshot + QBR action items
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly exec checkpoint: OKR snapshot + QBR action items

Team —

Quick weekly checkpoint ahead of the QBR packet deadline next Wednesday. I’ve pulled a short OKR snapshot and highlighted immediate asks so we can triage before the deck freeze. TL;DR: overall trajectory is steady; two rising risks on capacity and a customer escalation that may need an exec touchpoint.

Wins
- Redwood Dedicated adoption: two new committed accounts (acme) moved from proof-of-concept to reserved capacity — expected +18% committed GPU hours for Q1.
- Optimize PR merged (INF-2145) reducing tail latency by ~12% on p50 for 8k seqs.
- Developer onboarding NPS pilot completed, +16 pts vs baseline in the sandbox cohort.

Risks
1) Capacity mismatch for EU region: our autoscale config underestimates peak by ~22% on recent synthetic workload. Impact: latency SLOs could slip for four enterprise customers during peak. (Owner: Markus).
2) Procurement slowdown — one expansion (BigBank) has legal/procurement holding on contractual terms; they requested a SOC2 artifacts package and a signed addendum. If delayed, expected ARR pushout ~45 days. (Owner: Aditya).

Asks (near-term)
- Markus: urgent capacity plan + mitigation by Monday EOD. Outline short-term burst options and a rollback-ready autoscale tweak.
- Aditya: escalate procurement support and share the SOC2 bundle + CD signing timeline; loop in Security if needed.
- Tessa: finalize the one-slide risk summary for the QBR deck (due Tue 10:00 PT).
- Laura: confirm exec bullets (2) that you want me to present at the QBR.

Artifacts attached: OKR-snapshot-2026Q4.xlsx (summary), initial QBR outline in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/exec/QBR-Dec-2026

I’ll sync with each owner offline but wanted this on thread for visibility. If anyone needs a quick slot for a 15-min sync, reply with times.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Infrastructure & Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OKR-snapshot-2026Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet summary of key results)

Jonas — thanks for the concise snapshot. I’m comfortable with the two bullets: (1) Adoption lift with committed accounts and (2) latency improvement from Optimize PR. Please include a one-sentence callout on customer retention impact for the adoption bullet (e.g., estimated ARR influence).

I’ll be at the QBR to present the growth angle; if you want me to take the procurement escalation live with the customer, mark me.

Maya / all — quick replies inline and attached materials.

1) EU capacity runbook (owner: Markus) — draft steps attached and summarized here:
- Short-term: enable reserved burst pool for impacted customers (estimated incremental cost +$14k/week across the pool) — expected to buy 3 business days while we push a config fix.
- Mid-term: autoscale policy patch (INF-2149) to change headroom from 18% to 28% during business hours; expected cost delta +$9k/week but reduces SLA risk.
- Rollback plan: revert autoscale change and drain burst pool (5–10 min ops).

I’ve attached the runbook + cost table in QBR-Executive-Pack-Dec2026.pdf. Markus — please confirm the cost buckets and the short-term timeline; if good, we’ll call out the +$14k figure on the finance slide.

2) BigBank procurement contact: procurement@bigbank.com (cc’d in this thread as a placeholder). Aditya — can you confirm the individual name and expected turnaround for the SOC2 package? The documents they asked for are in the attached SOC2 evidence zip (artifact list) — I’ve summarized the requested items in the appendix of the QBR pack.

Action items & deadlines
- Markus: confirm runbook + cost buckets by Mon 12/7 11:00 PT.
- Aditya: provide named procurement contact and target signature timeline by Mon 12/7 15:00 PT.
- Tessa: submit final 1-slide risk summary to the deck by Tue 12/8 10:00 PT.
- Laura: confirm the two exec bullets by Tue 12/8 12:00 PT.

I attached: QBR-Executive-Pack-Dec2026.pdf (includes runbook, cost table, appendix with SOC2 artifact list) and OKR-snapshot-2026Q4.xlsx.

Thanks —
Jonas
VP, Infrastructure & Inference
